name: User Onboarding Flow
description: Complete user onboarding workflow triggered by user.created event

meta.name: User Onboarding Flow
meta.description: Complete user onboarding workflow triggered by user.created event
meta.failure_handling: retry with exponential backoff, dead letter after 3 attempts

parameters.bodyParametersJson:
{
  "idempotencyKey": "{{ $vars.correlationId }}:seed-demo",
  "action": "content.enqueue",
  "payload": {
    "user_id": "{{ $vars.userId }}",
    "type": "article",
    "title": "Getting Started with LightningFlow AI",
    "prompt": "Create a comprehensive guide for new users to get started with LightningFlow AI, including Lightning payments, AI agents, and portfolio management."
  },
  "source": "n8n",
  "workflow_id": "user-onboarding",
  "execution_id": "{{ $execution.id }}",
  "correlation_id": "{{ $vars.correlationId }}",
  "timestamp": "{{ new Date().toISOString() }}",
  "version": "1"
}

parameters.responseBody:
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "User onboarding completed successfully",
  "user_id": "{{ $vars.userId }}",
  "correlation_id": "{{ $vars.correlationId }}",
  "completed_at": "{{ new Date().toISOString() }}"
}
